3D computer graphics.fact: 3D computer graphics, sometimes called 3D computer-generated imagery (3D-CGI), refers to computer graphics that use a three-dimensional (3D) representation of geometric data (often Cartesian) stored in the computer for the purposes of performing calculations and rendering digital images, usually 2D images but sometimes 3D images.   3D computer graphics, contrary to what the name suggests, are most often displayed on two-dimensional displays.
